retirement.ask: Could you withdraw this now, without retiring or leaving work?

answers.label: Yes
answers.reason: your PF or NPS lets you withdraw this now

checklist.name: Bank accounts
checklist.ask: Do you have money in a bank account or a fixed deposit?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much, across all of them?

checklist.name: EPF
checklist.hint: Your EPFO passbook shows the balance.

checklist.name: NPS
checklist.ask: Do you have an NPS account?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much in Tier I?
checklist.hint: Add a Tier II account on its own: it can be withdrawn at any time.

checklist.name: Investments
checklist.ask: Any investments — shares, mutual funds, a demat account?
checklist.amount: Roughly what are they worth today?

checklist.name: PPF
checklist.ask: Do you have a PPF account?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is in it?

checklist.name: Gold
checklist.ask: Do you own gold — jewellery, coins or bars?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for today?

checklist.name: Home
checklist.ask: Do you own the home you live in?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Home loan
checklist.ask: Is there a home loan on it?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?
checklist.hint: Your latest loan statement shows what’s outstanding.

checklist.name: Vehicle
checklist.ask: Do you own a car or a two-wheeler?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Vehicle loan
checklist.ask: Is there a loan on it?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?

checklist.name: Other loans
checklist.ask: Anything else you owe — an education loan, a personal loan or a card balance?
